mentions.name: Papillon
mentions.description: Papillon is a real-time collaborative workspace for product teams that brings chat, docs, files, links, tasks, whiteboards, and calls into one place, organized around project channels as an alternative to jumping between Slack, Notion, and Linear. It emphasizes speed, a hacker/IDE feel, and offline support, and lets teams build small internal apps with AI directly inside the workspace — such as shared support rotas, spreadsheets, dashboards, and custom workflows — running in an isolated Cloudflare OS sandbox. It is available as a web app and a Tauri-based macOS app, with security/trust info and uptime history published on the site.
mentions.problem: Teams have to jump between separate tools like Slack, Notion, and Linear instead of working in one place.
mentions.audience: Product teams; also seeking small teams willing to try it
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Papillon: https://papillon.so, a real-time collaborative workspace for product teams.
